subject: subsecond apply_patch attempt for tip-crate code change
evidence_basis: PatchError::AndroidMemfd documents permission-scoped patch failure on Android
Subsecond separately documents stale-call unwind/retry, which is not the same as a successful patch application
caveats: The broader route family can still be valid even when one patch attempt fails
A running process with old code is not evidence that the new patch partially applied
